mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% is followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month & UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: If the joint condition is met but followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, boosting related sectors and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases are not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% QoQ signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
